paper.title_en: A dynamical Einstein-Proca-dilaton holographic model and exotic hybrid meson resonances
paper.abstract_en: A fully dynamical Einstein-Proca-dilaton (EPD) holographic model is developed for the exotic $J^{PC}=1^{-+}$ hybrid meson, incorporating the backreaction of the massive vector field dual to the hybrid current in the bulk. Solving the coupled EPD system yields a self-consistent gravitational background and the mass spectrum of hybrid resonances. While the soft-wall limit reproduces linear Regge behavior, the inclusion of backreaction yields quantitative shifts that improve agreement with experimental candidates. The finite-temperature regime is approached by studying black hole thermodynamics and spectral functions across the confinement-deconfinement transition, fixing the Hawking-Page temperature to $T_c \sim 150 \, \mathrm{MeV}$. Unlike non-backreacted AdS/QCD models, the dynamical background predicts a strong suppression of hybrid states already near the onset of deconfinement. These results demonstrate that gravitational backreaction has measurable consequences for both vacuum spectroscopy and in-medium properties of exotic hybrid mesons, emphasizing the relevance of a dynamical self-consistent approach in AdS/QCD.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文构建了完全动力学的 Einstein-Proca-dilaton 全息模型，在包含大质量矢量场反作用的情况下求解耦合系统，得到自洽引力背景与杂化介子共振谱，并进一步讨论有限温度下的黑洞热力学与谱函数；理论深度较高，方法自洽且跨越真空谱学与介质性质，值得研究人员点击阅读。引文数为零因论文不足30天，按规则视为中性、不加不减。
decision.title_zh: 一个动力学 Einstein-Proca-dilaton 全息模型与奇异杂化介子共振
decision.abstract_zh: 本文为奇异 $J^{PC}=1^{-+}$ 杂化介子构建了一个完全动力学的 Einstein-Proca-dilaton（EPD）全息模型，并在体时空中纳入对偶于杂化流的大质量矢量场的反作用。求解耦合的 EPD 系统可得到自洽的引力背景以及杂化共振的质量谱。虽然软墙极限可以重现线性 Regge 行为，但引入反作用会产生定量移动，从而改善与实验候选者的吻合。有限温度情形则通过研究黑洞热力学以及跨越禁闭—解禁闭相变的谱函数来接近，并将 Hawking-Page 温度固定为 $T_c \sim 150 \, \mathrm{MeV}$。与非反作用的 AdS/QCD 模型不同，动力学背景预言杂化态在接近解禁闭起始处就已经被强烈抑制。这些结果表明，引力反作用对奇异杂化介子的真空谱学和介质内性质都有可测量的后果，凸显了在 AdS/QCD 中采用动力学自洽方法的相关性。
